svg.aria-label: PRism — AI code review · GitHub Action. A precision-first AI code reviewer, run as a GitHub Action or CLI. One model proposes defects, a second tries to refute each, and only survivors are posted inline. PR code is treated as untrusted and never executed. Built with TypeScript, GitHub Actions, OpenRouter, Octokit, Zod, Vitest. on: pull_request · propose → refute → gate · PR head code never executed · field test: 3/3 on the right line · ✓ 156 Vitest tests
